name: LegacyKeeper — Emergency Evacuation
description: HTTP-triggered workflow that executes emergency asset evacuation when the panic button is pressed. Uses private routing for MEV protection and requires recovery key authentication.

authentication.description: Request must include a valid recovery key signature in the X-Recovery-Signature header

steps.name: Verify Recovery Key Signature

on_complete.message: 🚨 EMERGENCY EVACUATION EXECUTED — All assets transferred to safe vault. Tx: ${tx_hash}

steps.name: Log Audit Trail Entry

error_handling.message: ⚠️ Failed panic attempt — invalid recovery key signature. Wallet: ${walletAddress}
⚠️ Panic triggered but contract balance is 0. No assets to evacuate.
